scope: Read-only bounded primary-source review for Alpha RV112BCF-40 geometry; no model or project edits.
original_selection_evidence: Revision6 control-body-manifest.json retains original Ladyada BOM names and source URLs.

primary_source.title: 11mm Dual Gangs, Snap-In Series
primary_source.public_catalog_link_observed: Insulated shaft and metal shaft RV112B row links downloads?target=products&id=77

rejected_exact_variant_source.reason: Transparent Shaft RV112BCF-40-25AL family. Shared dimensional corroboration only; not exact original opaque shaft/material source.

manufacturer_cad_search.conclusion: No openly downloadable official RV112BCF-40 STEP/IGES/3D CAD found in this bounded search. Public official catalogue exposes a PDF drawing only for this family. This is not proof that no manufacturer CAD exists.

canonical_convention.origin: Original library origin in XY; housing rear datum at Z=0
canonical_convention.rule: Retain current model transform; apply actual KiCad footprint rotation and side flip once.

housing_axial_depth.interpretation: Rear housing datum to front sleeve seat; shaft L starts at rear datum, not sleeve front.

sleeve_diameter.interpretation: Smooth sleeve; do not add M9 threads from E1 sibling.

current25A_L.interpretation: Rear datum to shaft tip; retain Ztip=25.0, not 31.9 or Panasonic30.

current25A_flat_F_options.interpretation: 25A column explicitly provides both7 and12; chosen7 remains qualified and not historical25F confirmation.

side_internal_body_height.interpretation: Internal molded body side elevation; not complete front flange extent.

mounting_tab_pitch.interpretation: PCB mounting-hole detail; do not confuse with outer lower flange width13.6.

rearward_terminal_reach.interpretation: Terminal/bent lead geometry, not body axial height.

terminal_end_from_axis_in_side_elevation.interpretation: Below/negativeY terminal reach; do not enlarge body to this dimension.

full_CCW_shaft_flat_clocking_deg.interpretation: Drawing pose only. Arbitrary visual shaft pose must not claim this electrical state.

shaft_tip_taper_radial_reduction.interpretation: Two0.5mm radial reductions shown at upper/lower tip in side elevation. This is neither2mm axial length nor2.0 +/-0.5. Verified600dpi crop arrows span radial gap fromD6surface to tip surface.

shaft_tip_nominal_diameter_derived.qualification: Derived taper-cylinder diameter only; not separately printed, and flat intersection remains source-shaped. Axial taper length and angle are unsized.

detail_features_supported_by_outline_and.feature: Narrow molded dual-gang stack inside folded metal cage with overhanging front flange
detail_features_supported_by_outline_and.status: Shape and material distinction visible; exact wafer layer thicknesses, splits and cage stock thickness are unsized.

detail_features_supported_by_outline_and.feature: Stepped upper front11/12mm widths and widened lower13/13.6mm outline
detail_features_supported_by_outline_and.status: Widths printed; transitions, corner radii, flange stock thickness and exact axial extrusion split are unsized.

detail_features_supported_by_outline_and.feature: Four circular front cage fastener/rivet indications
detail_features_supported_by_outline_and.status: Visible in drawing; diameters and local centers unsized. Do not claim them as confirmed clearance through-holes.

detail_features_supported_by_outline_and.feature: Side cage notches/tabs, rear cage folds and lower central folded tongue
detail_features_supported_by_outline_and.status: Visible contours; local sizes and depths unsized reconstruction.

detail_features_supported_by_outline_and.feature: Black/opaque insulating sleeve and flatted shaft
detail_features_supported_by_outline_and.status: Opaque plastic supported by correct-family source photograph and plastic shaft description; exact resin/finish not established.
Dual unit and six terminals established. Carrier shape, color and layer thickness may be approximated and must be labeled unsized.

detail_features_supported_by_outline_and.feature: Shaft shoulder, taper/chamfer at tip and end relief
detail_features_supported_by_outline_and.status: ShaftD6, acrossflat4.5 and two0.5mm radial tip reductions are dimensioned. Tip taper axial length/angle, shoulder blending and end relief remain unsized.

reconstruction_limits: Historical original25F suffix is not rewritten to25A. Current25A family dimensions may inform a qualified visual derivative only.

Primary77 family model table labels RV112BCF-40 terminal type Horizontal despite vertical terminal drawing/current distributor terminology. Preserve this source inconsistency; actual footprint and drawing govern orientation.
No exact historical part CAD, mold revision, wafer stock, body seating gap, tolerance stack or installed shaft rotation established.
Body-only asset must omit leads and mounting legs unless separately qualified and fit checked; no below-seat metal implied by body-only reconstruction.
No enclosure clearance-driven shrink, shaft shortening or model transform changes.
Manufacturer drawings retain original rights; only independently generated reconstruction geometry may use the project geometry license.
